  <p class="visually-hidden" id="rf-desc">Research overview in three panels. Panel A, physical dynamics, shows profiles of a Kuramoto-Sivashinsky solution that start smooth and become chaotic. Panel B, neural solvers, shows the solution fields for three initial conditions, each returned by a neural operator in one forward pass. Panel C, Model2Action, shows that the solution error stays nearly constant across operating points and that the decision error, measured as regret, rises sharply near an active constraint. An arrow from C back to B shows that the decision error trains the solver.</p>
